analysis.summary: Srivari Spices and Foods Limited reported revenue of Rs. 78.77 crore and PAT of Rs. 7.20 crore for H1 FY26, representing a year-on-year revenue growth of 49.08%. The company announced plans to expand its product portfolio by launching a new business vertical focused on devotional and puja articles. Management highlighted expectations of stronger financial performance in H2 FY26 driven by higher utilization in the newly launched Oil vertical and sustained growth across its core products.

guidance.claim: Management stated that H2 will deliver better performance than H1, supported by improved revenue picking up from the newly launched Oil category.
guidance.quote: So, H2 will be better in the Oil. So, that will be picked up very well. So, H2 will be better than H1.

guidance.claim: The company expects its growth rate across revenue, EBITDA, and PAT percentage to be better than its performance over the past three years.
guidance.quote: What we did in the past 3 years that will be better than, in percentage wise you will find everything better, EBITDA as well as PAT and revenue, all will be better than in percentage.

guidance.claim: Management expects FY27 to be the best year in the company's past history.
guidance.quote: But it will be better than, FY '27 will be the best in our past complete history.

demand_outlook.claim: The company stated that the demand environment remains encouraging and expressed confidence in sustaining growth momentum in H2.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of approximately 6% from 2024 to 2029.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 –2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake.
demand_outlook.quote: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake (Source: Indian Market Research Bureau).

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that groundnut oil sales typically account for 7% to 8% of the overall oil segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Generally, overall if you see the positioning of the groundnut oil is percentage wise 7% to 8% is the overall sales of this oil segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Telangana is a major producer of groundnut and the factory's location within a 50-kilometer radius provides complete sourcing.
demand_outlook.quote: This Telangana is the biggest producer of the groundnut parallelly and specifically our location of factory 50 kilometer radius is a complete sourcing.

capex_expansion.claim: Srivari Spices plans to introduce a new business vertical for manufacturing, trading, and distribution of devotional items and puja articles.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading and distribution of puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items and allied products.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to launch its devotional products business roughly in January.
capex_expansion.quote: In Jan, roughly in the Jan, we are going to launch.

capex_expansion.claim: The company will decide on manufacturing capacity setup and CAPEX for Soya Chunks after two quarters of market testing.
capex_expansion.quote: So, once after the 2 quarters only, we can go for the capacities and what will be the CAPEX required.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning geographic expansion into Karnataka, Gujarat, and Odisha.
capex_expansion.quote: But we are in the pipeline with the Karnataka, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, Karnataka and this Odisha.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched an oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on July 28, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on 28 July 2025 .

capex_expansion.claim: The new edible oil plant was launched and commenced commercial production on 10th May 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: and we launched our edible oil on 10th May 2025 and it started its commercial production on 10th May 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The newly installed oil manufacturing facility has an installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Regarding oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum but this plant is yet to be commercialized.

margins_costs.claim: In H1 FY26, the company reported an EBITDA margin of 17.05% and a PAT margin of 9.14%.
margins_costs.quote: Our profitability remained healthy with EBITDA margin of 17.05% and PAT margin of 9.14%.

margins_costs.claim: The company spends between Rs. 5 lakhs to Rs. 6 lakhs monthly on media and regional TV advertising channels.
margins_costs.quote: So, altogether monthly we are spending Rs. 5-Rs. 6 lakhs on the media channels, new media channels.

margins_costs.claim: The Oil division is currently operating at EBITDA breakeven level.
margins_costs.quote: No, exactly breakeven only, not in the losses.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for H1 FY26 was reported at 17.05%.
Profit margin for H1 FY26 was reported at 9.14%.
For oil, ghee, and other products, the cart value is 15% to 20% with margins of 18% to 22%.
margins_costs.quote: And oil and ghee and other products, cart value will be 15% to 20%; margins will be 18% to 22%.

margins_costs.claim: Management explained that net profit decreased due to the new plant commencement and claiming depreciation for six months.
margins_costs.quote: See PAT has been decreased due to the new plant commencement and we have claimed the depreciation of the 6 months because of that PAT has been decreased, but our overall numbers are positive.

orders_capacity.claim: For Spices, the company has an installed capacity of 3,600 tons and utilized 2,637 tons in H1.
orders_capacity.quote: For Spices, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons and we have utilized 2,637 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: For Oil, the installed capacity is 7,200 tons, with 720 tons utilized in H1.
orders_capacity.quote: When it comes to Oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons and we have utilized 720 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The company targets scaling capacity utilization in the Oil segment to 30% during H2.
orders_capacity.quote: We can reach up to 30%. Now, we can utilize up to 30% in this H2.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity for spices and masalas is 3,600 tons per annum with current utilization at about 2,637 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: For spices and masalas, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons per annum with the current utilization at about 2,637 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity for atta is 14,400 tons per annum with 12,650 tons utilized.
orders_capacity.quote: When it comes to atta, 14,400 tons per annum installed capacity and we have utilized 12,650 tons.

capital_allocation.claim: An overdraft taken on the last day of September contributed significantly to the increase in short-term borrowings.
capital_allocation.quote: Actually, mainly there was one OD came on the last day of September. So, that contributed so much towards short-term borrowings.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has completely divested Srivari Supply Chain, which is no longer its wholly owned subsidiary.
capital_allocation.quote: It is no more connected to Srivari, the supply chain and the Paushtik. It belongs to the supply chain and that company is no longer a wholly owned subsidiary company.

capital_allocation.claim: Rights shares were issued on October 10, 2024 to enhance the capital structure.
capital_allocation.quote: Rights Shares issued on 10th Oct, 2024 to enhance capital structure.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the company has a bank facility limit of INR12 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: INR12 crores is a facility, INR200 lakhs is a facility with the banking.

capital_allocation.claim: The Company Secretary stated that the rights issue proceeds were fully utilized for the specified objects in the letter of offer without any deviation.
capital_allocation.quote: So, as disclosed in the letter of offer, we have utilized the entire amount for the specified purpose without any deviation.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced market entry challenges during its geographical expansion into Maharashtra due to established incumbents.
risks_headwinds.quote: Even we are expanding the geographical also, but as we launched in the Maharashtra, so we are having a very tough time in the Maharashtra.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that growth targets were not met last year due to challenges of the new setup and delay in the rights issue.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, actually, due to the delay in the rights and raising the capitals, our numbers were now up to the mark as I said, but we will be maintaining this as just now, I think you are joined now, right?

management_commitments.claim: Srivari Spices plans to launch its new puja and devotional products category in January.
management_commitments.quote: In Jan, roughly in the Jan, we are going to launch.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that FY27 will be the best performing period in the company's past history.
management_commitments.quote: But it will be better than, FY '27 will be the best in our past complete history.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to schedule expansion for Atta and Spices after the next financial year within a two-year timeframe.
management_commitments.quote: Within 2 years, we have to plan. It will take some time. After the next financial year, we have to go for the expansion plan.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
